message:
docs(field): record the 11:27 freeze host packet-capture analysis and its limits (history #415)

First pktmon round on the host (11:24:50-11:31:41, UDP 43000 + viewer IP, snaplen 192, 106,256
packets, no capture loss reported) cross-checked against NAS viewer/host logs. Verified boundary:
the viewer's last datagram (11:27:36.314 viewer clock, ~ -375 ms vs host) is gen6 seq 40359 idx 27;
the host kept sending at the NDIS layer to the old peer until 11:27:43.808, answered NACK round 0
with all 30 chunks, the reverse direction kept arriving, and a new source port reconnect recovered.
Unresolved: the capture holds only part of the host's transmit (same-AU comparison), so AU
completeness, NACK round 1/2 replies and seq gaps cannot be judged; drop location unknown.
Status-only updates in the plan and task list. Artifacts stay untracked under .claude/.
